provenance.source: cuRoboV2 (NVlabs/curobo main) motion planning: IK -> TrajOpt -> TimeOpt
provenance.model_version: NVlabs/curobo main as fetched (cuRoboV2 / cuRoboV2-Fast C++ runtime defaults)
provenance.notes: FALLBACK (spec V3): no GPU profile. analytic_count of kernel FLOPs/bytes from cuRobo's algorithms and default parameters read from the repo; published_numbers (repo benchmarks, paper Table 4) used only for the sanity check in params.sanity_check. Event-triggered (sporadic).

assumptions.scene: ESDF from T3 (not OBB primitives as in the benchmark)

motion_plan_mean_ms.source: cuRobo repo docs/reference/benchmarks.rst, Franka, with inverse dynamics

paper_table4_rtx4090.source: Sundaralingam, Murali, Birchfield, cuRoboV2, arXiv 2603.05493v2, Table 4 (RTX 4090)

sanity_check.reading: Low implied utilization is expected: these kernels are latency-bound (small batches, many dependent iterations, launch and synchronization overhead), which is why the graph has one op per kernel launch and per iteration: the core charges launch overhead per op and keeps the iterations serial.
